review_description: System up and running. Had to have entire fuse box replaced due to not up to date included $750 in the quote. Still waiting on the changeover to new provider. From 22 December. On site inspection on day of quote. Easy to negotiate if you know your facts about solar. Which solar quotes armed me with the right questions so I was able to get better panels installed at same price.Installation was on time and quick. Language barrier with installer was hard to understand with broken English. After sales text messages were great and timely.

I chose them as a result of a recommendation from a friend. the process from the first phone call to quotes and install was professional and am very happy with the product and the workmanship. The installers were polite and professional on the day.i never felt pressured to buy a system as some of the other company's did. I feel confident this company will be around for any problems that may arise in the future.

The process of getting quote was easy and the Sales representative was very polite and not pushy at all. Installers did clean and Tidy job, the cleaned my place before they left. After installation they have organized Grid connection with my retailer. I can recommend them to anyone who is looking for solar.
